title: Push the wrench harder
hook: Change force and predict torque magnitude.
misconception: torque magnitude stays fixed when force doubles.
objective: Apply τ = rF to compare torque magnitude when force changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With the same perpendicular lever arm about a fixed pivot, τ = rF. When force doubles, torque magnitude becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model τ = rF; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider the same perpendicular lever arm about a fixed pivot, with a nonzero initial result. If force triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on torque magnitude?
recall.why: Apply τ = rF under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
